cards.finding: Compared the actual printed scan with the retained art: startled wide eyes and pupils, open tooth-and-tongue mouth, pointing index finger and connected hand, orange gi, blue undershirt and white collar remain. Burst setting and source crop retained; watermark obscures part of the original upper-left hair/background.

Compared horned character's inward gaze through black spectacles, worried tooth-showing mouth, center-parted hair, orange skin and white shoulder garment. Pose and pink setting agree in visible reference areas; the watermark masks part of the left horn.

Compared Vegeta's upward side glance, asymmetric closed smirk, white/gold armor and blue undersuit. The prior localized removal of the invented gold ear stud is retained; the final ear has skin-colored cartilage. No new pose or costume discrepancy found.

Compared Bulma's profile, wide visible eye, small open mouth, sweat drop, red earring, teal bangs and dark rocky backdrop. Preserve the close-up and source-visible shoulder; the original's tiny mouth detail is limited by scan resolution.

Compared Roshi's lowered head, opaque glasses, white brows/beard, green shirt and blue sky with broad clouds. Mouth and eyes are hidden by beard/lenses, so hidden expression details are not a fidelity pass.

Compared Yajirobe's narrowed eyes, corn held across his mouth, connected gripping hand, long hair, orange wrap garment and black wristband. Mouth is obscured by corn. The retained illustration has no new crop or missing limb from this update.

Compared Krillin's raised brows, wide eyes, open surprised mouth, orange gi, blue wristband and lifted right hand. The earlier right-edge hand continuation remains intact. Exact edge-finger detail is limited by the small printed scan and watermark; no speculative repaint.

Compared the fleeing child's frightened open mouth, outstretched arms, white shirt and green trousers with the pursuing dinosaur's wide toothy mouth, red tongue and legs. Red/pink sky and broad clouds are retained. Fine details in the small child's fingers are unresolved at original scan resolution.

Compared Nappa's foreshortened tilted face, wide visible eye, clenched teeth, purple scouter, brown armor panels and white trim. Retained diagonal overlap and close crop remain coherent; no newly missing anatomy.

Compared Nappa's stern narrow eyes, blue scouter, moustache, closed downturned mouth and brown/white armor edge against green. Original close-up is retained without new zoom; scouter reflections remain a modern shading treatment.

Compared Nappa's angled head, asymmetrical eye openings, broad tooth-showing grin, facial hair and bare shoulder. The original close crop is retained. Watermark obscures a small upper-left background/shoulder region.
Compared Vegeta's low-angled intense brows, green scouter, open tooth-showing smirk and white-edged armor neckline. Facial gesture and visible costume agree; close-up framing is unchanged.

Compared Raditz's side-facing tense mouth, green scouter, long hair, brown shoulder armor and white trim. Sparse dark space and small ringed planet are retained. Earlier background correction remains; the watermark obscures part of the original planet.
Compared Raditz's shouting mouth, teeth/tongue, narrowed visible eye and green scouter. Preserve the original extreme close-up and inherited edge crop. No added zoom or pose change in this revision.

Compared King Kai's blue face, opaque glasses, curved brows, whiskers and red/gold collar. The prior small closed-smile correction is present and matches the visible original mouth direction. Eyes are concealed by lenses. Checked the supplied Expanded CRD: six life-card damage and successful-hit loss of three stages, minimum zero, remain correct.

Compared seated Goku's halo, upward gaze at Gregory, orange gi, blue shirt/cuff, bent leg and grounded supporting hand; Bubbles, buildings and pump remain. Gregory's tiny facial details cannot be resolved from the original scan. Attack-or-block power keeps one attack icon.

Compared King Kai's raised index finger, mild closed smile, sunglasses, black/red/gold robe, chest mark and purple shoes against pink sky and grass. Finger-to-hand connection and clothing remain coherent. Upper antenna detail is partly at the reference edge.

Compared the extreme sunglasses close-up, cyan reflections, blue skin and source crop. Eyes and mouth are concealed/outside the view, so those expression checks are not applicable. The illustration is unchanged; only the outer Black Style frame palette is updated.

Compared Baba's narrowed eyes, dark hat, purple hair, two hands around the blue orb, dark sleeves and lower interior background. Mouth is hidden by the orb. Retained fingers and wrists remain connected; no new artwork crop.

Compared Krillin's two hands raised to his forehead, wide eyes, open surprised mouth, orange gi, blue cuffs/belt and grassy backdrop. Both arms remain connected. Attack-or-block wording retains only the attack icon; anger gain and costs remain unchanged. Fine finger contours are limited by scan resolution.
